description: This file defines a custom Android activity that demonstrates the use of property animation with a custom evaluator to animate shape objects (balls) across the screen. It includes inner classes for data holding, custom type evaluation, and a custom view that manages drawing and animating animated objects.

classes.name: CustomEvaluator
classes.description: Android activity that sets up an animation demonstrating a custom object evaluator for moving shapes.

classes.name: XYHolder
classes.description: Data class holding X and Y coordinate values, used as a value type in animations.

classes.name: XYEvaluator
classes.description: Implements TypeEvaluator to interpolate between XYHolder objects during animations.

classes.name: BallXYHolder
classes.description: Wrapper class linking XY position data to a ShapeHolder representing a ball.

classes.name: MyAnimationView
classes.description: Custom view that manages drawing and animating a ball shape with property animation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates layout, and sets up the animation trigger button.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Starts the custom property animation of the ball.

methods.name: createBall
methods.description: Creates a ShapeHolder object representing a colored ball with gradient shading.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the current state of the ball shape onto the canvas.

methods.name: onAnimationUpdate
methods.description: Callback invoked during animation updates; invalidates view to trigger redraw.
